title: Odawara Castle · Hikari west · Tō-ji's last flea market of the year · fugu feast in Minami · Hozenji lanterns · Ura-Namba crawl

stops.name: Breakfast and last soak at the villa
stops.plan: Finish the A-Coop drinks and snacks, one last hot-spring soak, then pack the overnight bags (suitcases are already waiting in Osaka).

stops.name: Check out Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Out by 09:30 with overnight bags only (suitcases went ahead to Kujō by TA-Q-BIN); the bus to Odawara takes up to three hours with changes, so two pre-booked taxis.
stops.transport: Taxi to Odawara Castle, 37 min (2 cars, book with the villa the night before)

stops.name: Odawara Castle
stops.plan: Up the white keep for the view over Sagami Bay and the samurai-armour floor, then walk to the station and buy ekiben and beers for the train.

stops.name: Shinkansen Odawara → Kyoto (Kodama, change to Hikari at Shizuoka)
stops.plan: Kodama 11:42 to Shizuoka (12:31), then Hikari 12:49 to Kyoto (14:26), reserved seats together for 8; Tokaido Shinkansen, so not on the Kansai-Hiroshima pass, which starts tomorrow. Ekiben lunch on board, Fuji on the right after Odawara.
stops.transport: Coin-locker the bags at Kyoto Station, then walk to Tō-ji, 11 min (or Kintetsu one stop to Tōji)

stops.name: Tō-ji Shimai-Kōbō
stops.plan: The last Kōbō-san of the year: 1,000+ stalls of vintage kimono, antiques, New Year food and street snacks around Japan's tallest wooden pagoda; split into fours, cash only, regroup at the pagoda.
stops.transport: Walk to Kyoto Station (collect bags), JR Special Rapid to Osaka, JR Loop line to Nishikujō, Hanshin one stop to Kujō, about 75 min

stops.name: Check in Kujō House
stops.plan: Check in, find the TA-Q-BIN suitcases, shower, change for the night and grab original passports.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line Kujō → Osaka-Namba, Kintetsu one stop to Kintetsu-Nippombashi and walk, about 35 min

stops.name: Genpin Fugu
stops.plan: Booked course for 8: tessa sashimi, tecchiri hot-pot, fugu karaage and the porridge finish, with 2 hours of all-you-can-drink and hot fin sake.

stops.name: Hozenji Yokocho
stops.plan: Splash water on the moss-covered Fudō statue for luck, then a quick drink in pairs at the tiny alley bars.

stops.name: Ura-Namba bar crawl
stops.plan: Two squads of four hop the standing bars and yakiton counters between Sennichimae and Kuromon, one or two drinks per stop; home by midnight because Fushimi Inari is at first light tomorrow.
stops.transport: Walk to Osaka-Namba for the last Hanshin Namba line train 23:56 to Kujō (00:03), 16 min door to door; taxi about ¥1,900 per car if it is missed

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Bed; alarms for the 06:00 Fushimi Inari start.
